assets.title: Week 5 fashion figure opener board
assets.description: A simple fashion figure or croquis wearing one clear garment, designed for quick review of garment language and preview of pose and view language.
assets.notes: Use as a quick review-preview board. Keep the garment, one visible detail, and one clear pose or view cue easy to identify.

assets.title: Body reference points diagram
assets.description: A neutral front-view fashion figure diagram with clear body-reference points for head, neck, shoulder, arm, elbow, hand, waist, hip, leg, knee, and foot.
assets.notes: Required visible-key strategy: A head, B neck, C shoulder, D waist, E hip, F knee. The image, activity answers, and prompt notes must all use the same A-F labels, and the student must be able to see those keys directly on the board.

assets.title: Figure and sketch vocabulary board
assets.description: A concept board showing a fashion figure, a croquis or sketch, and clear examples of outline, silhouette, front view, side view, and pose differences.
assets.notes: Required visible-key strategy: A figure, B croquis, C outline, D silhouette, E front view, F side view. The image, activity answers, and prompt notes must all use the same A-F labels, and the student must be able to see those keys directly on the board.

assets.title: Labeled fashion figure with point keys
assets.description: One front-view fashion figure with explicit visible point keys A-H for body-reference labeling.
assets.notes: Required point-key strategy: A head, B neck, C shoulder, D arm, E waist, F hip, G leg, H foot. The image, activity answers, and prompt notes must all use the same A-H labels.

assets.title: Reusable four-figure gallery
assets.description: A reusable gallery with four clearly separated fashion figures for listening, reading, writing, and speaking.
assets.notes: Required image-key strategy: image A is standing in front view with a simple dress and short sleeves, image B is relaxed in side view with a jacket and pants, image C is walking with a blouse and skirt, image D is standing with one hand on the hip wearing a fitted top and wide pants.

assets.title: Describe the pose listening audio
assets.description: A short Week 5 listening clip describing four fashion figures by pose, view, garment, and one visible detail.
assets.notes: Transcript remains inside audio_prompts.json only. Do not create a separate transcript asset in the current phase.
